title: ISERR and ISERROR include newer errors (#GETTING_DATA, #BUSY!, #SPILL!, #FIELD!, #CALC!) while returning FALSE on IMAGE rich values
statement: In Excel 16.0 builds 20430 and 20527, ISERROR(value) returns TRUE for every worksheet error—including newer errors #GETTING_DATA, #BUSY!, #SPILL!, #FIELD!, and #CALC! alongside the seven classic error codes—while ISERR(value) returns TRUE for every worksheet error except #N/A, and ISNA(value) returns TRUE for #N/A alone. All three return FALSE on a _webimage rich value produced by IMAGE (even though OOXML serializes its fallback as t="e" #VALUE!). Each matches 1,227/1,227 full-bank and 120/120 pinned rows.
basis: Measured across Excel 16.0.20527.20196 (dc_nzpw rows 9-38, 149-151, 174-176, 181-182), Excel 16.0.20527 (fetch.rs rows 514-515), and 1,227/1,227 full-bank and 120/120 pinned rows for each function.
